question.:question/problem:
What is the augmented matrix for the following system of linear equations?

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}x-y &=1 \\ -3x-11y &=1\end{aligned}\right.
$$
question.:question/worked-solution:
First, we organize the system so that the variables are ordered $x,y$ on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient:

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}x-y &=1 \\ -3x-11y &=1\end{aligned}\right.
$$

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

$$
\begin{bmatrix}1 & -1 \\ -3 & -11\end{bmatrix}
$$

The augmented matrix is the coefficient matrix augmented with the column that represents the right-hand sides of the equations:

$$
\left[\begin{array}{cc|c}1 & -1 & 1 \\ -3 & -11 & 1\end{array}\right]
$$

What is the augmented matrix for the following system of linear equations?

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}24y &=11+17x \\ -3x-y+1 &=0\end{aligned}\right.
$$
question.:question/worked-solution:
First, we organize the system so that the variables are ordered $x,y$ on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient:

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}-17x+24y &=11 \\ -3x-y &=-1\end{aligned}\right.
$$

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

$$
\begin{bmatrix}-17 & 24 \\ -3 & -1\end{bmatrix}
$$

The augmented matrix is the coefficient matrix augmented with the column that represents the right-hand sides of the equations:

$$
\left[\begin{array}{cc|c}-17 & 24 & 11 \\ -3 & -1 & -1\end{array}\right]
$$

$$
\begin{bmatrix}1 & -8 \\ 1 & 9\end{bmatrix}
$$

The augmented matrix is the coefficient matrix augmented with the column that represents the right-hand sides of the equations:

$$
\left[\begin{array}{cc|c}1 & -8 & 20 \\ 1 & 9 & -2\end{array}\right]
